_meta.verificationStatus: Transcribed from user-supplied Mondelēz International VDP policy + uploaded HackerOne structured scope CSV. Re-verify against the live HackerOne policy before testing.
_meta.matchingSemantics: IMPORTANT: the HackerOne scope export contains 344 URL assets and 1 OTHER asset; it contains NO WILDCARD assets. Treat each eligible URL identifier as the specifically listed URL/domain asset only. Do not infer authorization for arbitrary subdomains. Four CSV assets are explicitly ineligible for submission and must be deny entries. Policy also prohibits testing any system not listed in Appendix A and any third-party website/application/service merely linked to or integrated with Mondelēz systems.

machineScopeTypes.URL: 344 CSV entries. Exact listed HackerOne assets; not wildcard authorization.
machineScopeTypes.OTHER: 1 CSV entry: Leaked Credentials; explicitly ineligible for submission.

policyOutOfScope: Any system not specified in Appendix A: In-scope systems
Third-party websites, applications, or services that integrate with or link to/from Mondelēz International systems

authentication.testAccountGuidance: Where possible, self-register using <HackerOne-username>+x@wearehackerone.com / your @wearehackerone.com alias.
accountRules: No credentials are provided by the program.
Do not use exposed credentials to continue testing without written consent from Mondelēz International.
Only self-register where the in-scope application provides registration.

notes: Include the testing source IP address in the submission.
Tell the program which custom header value was used.

programRules: Notify the program immediately upon discovery of real or potential security issues.
Discard and purge any stored Mondelēz International data upon reporting a vulnerability.
Do not test systems outside Appendix A.
Do not perform DoS, DDoS, or testing that may disrupt, impair, or disable systems.
Do not socially engineer employees, contractors, or customers.
Do not physically test facilities or resources.
Do not send phishing, vishing, or other unsolicited social-engineering communications.
Exploit only the minimal amount required to identify an indicator of the vulnerability.
Do not compromise, copy, or exfiltrate data.
Do not test third-party sites, applications, or services linked to or integrated with Mondelēz systems.
If sensitive, personally identifiable, or proprietary data is encountered, stop testing immediately and report it.
Do not discuss the program or vulnerabilities, including resolved vulnerabilities, outside the program without express written consent from Mondelēz International.
reportRequirements: Step-by-step reproduction instructions with technical details
safeHarbor: Research conducted in accordance with the policy is considered authorized. Mondelēz International states it will not recommend or pursue legal action against activities performed in accordance with the policy.
